item.title: Toyota Names 20 Racers for TGR Esports National Finals
item.description: Twenty sim racers will compete for national titles and Team Philippines slots at the Toyota Gazoo Racing Philippines Esports GT Championship finals on September 27. Toyota Motor Philippines selected the top 10 players in the Sporting Class and Junior Class from more than 400 participants nationwide.
